items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: That was under the direction of Leon Herniford.

ctx.x: I would say the highlight of my musical career was during the thirties. I was playing up and down Central Avenue. I'd say the highlights would be when we were playing the Lincoln Theater because we were exposed to the whole
town on the stage. That was under the direction of Leon Herniford. I think I mentioned that earlier. I don't know if I mentioned the personnel of that band.
No, you didn't. Would you please do that for us?
